title: ASIC Technical Project Manager (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
description:
Company Description

Since its spin-off in September 2025 AUMOVIO continues the business of the former Continental group sector Automotive as an independent company. The technology and electronics company offers a wide-ranging portfolio that makes mobility safe, exciting, connected, and autonomous. This includes sensor solutions, displays, braking and comfort systems as well as comprehensive expertise in software, architecture platforms, and assistance systems for software-defined vehicles. In the fiscal year 2024 the business areas, which now belong to AUMOVIO, generated sales of 19.6 billion Euro. The company is headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany and has about 87.000 employees in more than 100 locations worldwide.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced ASIC Technical Project Manager (m/f/d) to lead the development of automotive-grade integrated circuits (ICs). This role is critical in managing cross-functional R&D teams to deliver high-quality ASICs that meet stringent automotive standards such as ISO 26262 and AEC-Q100.

In addition to project leadership, the role includes a responsibility for shaping and improving the ASIC development process, ensuring alignment with internal methodologies (PLC/MLC) and continuous enhancement of development efficiency and quality. The ASIC Technical Project Manager (m/f/d) will oversee planning, execution and delivery of IC development projects, ensuring alignment with cost, schedule and quality targets.

Key Responsibilities:

Project Leadership & Coordination

- Managing an IC R&D project team to define, plan, realize and deliver agreed work products in accordance with automotive quality and safety standards
- Leading cross-functional teams including requirements engineering, architecture, design, verification, IP integration and tool support
- Convening and moderating regular and milestone-based R&D project meetings

Planning & Execution

- Developing detailed R&D project plans and providing inputs to the overall program management
- Managing implementation of project plan contents, ensuring timely and budget-compliant execution
- Providing budget requirements including effort estimation, tools, licenses and hardware
- Issuing work orders to specialist departments and ensuring alignment with project goals

Monitoring & Reporting

- Reporting development progress and status of the ASIC project to the Program Manager
- Monitoring and controlling all R&D project processes, ensuring adherence to schedule, budget and automotive compliance
- Providing project team members with necessary plans, updates and technical documentation
- Applying quality assurance practices including lessons-learned, peer reviews and risk assessments

Change & Risk Management

- Applying configuration and change management processes rigorously
- Participating in Change Control Board (CCB) meetings and managing R&D-related changes according to defined processes
- Supporting component cost estimation and strategic decision-making
- Ensuring project objectives are met in terms of budget, schedule and technical/quality targets

Process Improvement & Governance

- Supporting definition, maintenance and continuous improvement of the ASIC Development Process (e.g. COT / Turn-Key flows)
- Ensuring alignment of project execution with defined process phases, milestones and maturity levels (PLC/MLC)
- Supporting standardization of work products, templates and review criteria across projects
- Contributing to milestone review definitions and ensuring compliance with process requirements
- Driving lessons learned and feedback into process improvements
- Supporting process compliance with automotive standards such as ISO 26262

Key Success Factors

- Successful delivery of ASIC projects on time, budget and quality
- High level of cross-functional team alignment and execution efficiency
- Compliance with automotive standards and internal processes
- Continuous improvement of development processes and project performance

Qualifications

- Academic degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics or comparable qualifiaction
- Long-term experience in ASIC/IC development and technical project management, preferably in the automotive domain
- Experience with functional safety and FTA, FMEA, FMEDA processes
- Experience with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, Confluence)
- Experience with process modelling tools (e.g., ARMS Stages, Confluence)
- Strong background in IC design methodology, analog circuit design and EDA tools
- Deep expertise in CMOS (analog, digital, RF) and BCD technologies
- Proven track record in automotive product development and IC design
- Strong understanding of automotive IC development lifecycle, including ISO 26262 and PPAP
- Familiarity with automotive-grade reliability and qualification standards (e.g., AEC-Q100)
- Knowledge of automotive mission profiles and environmental stress testing
- Business fluent German and English language skills (written and spoken)
- Excellent communication, leadership and organizational skills
- Ability to manage distributed teams across global locations
- Strong communication skills and customer focus

Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.

Additional Information

- Next to the interesting daily work the region around Regensburg is offering a high recreational value and quality of life.
- Profit from extensive benefits at the location such as different canteens and cafeterias, a continuing education and training, health management, physiotherapy and much more.
- We offer an attractive salary as well as the possibility of hybrid and cross-border mobile work.
- For an improved work-life balance we support you with various initiatives for a better compatibility of family and career such as flexible work time model, part-time option, sabbatical, etc.
- You can expect a highly motivated team as well as diverse topics and projects in the global environment of the automotive industry.
- We are promoting lifelong Learning combined with personal and professional development.
- You are looking for an individual working time model? We support part-time work.

You would like to learn more about our additional services? Click here (https://www.aumovio.com/en/career/why-join-us.html) .

title: Expert ASIC Analog Design Engineer (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
description:
Company Description

At AUMOVIO, we own what we do: Developing and producing hardware, software, and services that shape the future of mobility. But what truly sets us apart are our people. People who thrive in our winning culture, driven by bold ideas. People who take a leap and create meaningful difference—together. Because we believe that the future belongs to those who own it. That’s why we foster a culture where you own every step of the way.
Own your career, your growth, your skills, and your impact. Join us and own what’s next.

Advanced Electronics & Semiconductor Solutions (AESS) organization has been established in AUMOVIO to develop and manufacture semiconductors in a fabless model to fulfilling strategic internal semiconductor demands.

Job Description

As an ASIC Analog Design Engineer (m/f/d), you will act as a technical authority for analog and mixed-signal high-voltage IC development. This role goes beyond block ownership and requires technical leadership across architecture, requirements breakdown, methodology, risk mitigation, and chip-level integration. You will make high-impact decisions for safety-critical automotive ASICs, guide complex trade-offs across disciplines, mentor engineers, and ensure critical know-how is applied consistently across projects. Your contribution directly influences product quality, execution, innovation, and the long-term competitiveness of the analog design organization.

Your Tasks:

- Acting as key technical authority for analog and mixed-signal ASIC development, guiding complex high-voltage automotive products from concept to qualification
- Owning chip-level architecture and design trade-offs across performance, robustness, safety, EMC/ESD, testability, cost, schedule, and manufacturability
- Leading complex analog block definition and implementation in BCD technologies, including SMPSs, LDOs, gate drivers, charge pumps, sensor interfaces, and protections
- Translating system and customer requirements into robust chip- and block-level specifications, identifying risks and verification needs early
- Representing analog design in technical negotiations with internal customers, architecture, project management, verification, digital, layout, test, technology, and quality teams

title: Elektrokonstrukteur / Elektroprojektierer / Steuerungstechniker (w/m/d) (Techniker/in - Elektrotechnik (Automatisierungstechnik)/Bachelor Professional in Technik)
description:
Die NOVAPAC Verpackungsmaschinen GmbH und die MASCHINPEX Maschinenbau GmbH sind zwei mittelständische Unternehmen im Sondermaschinenbau mit Sitz in Wangen im Allgäu. Beide Unternehmen werden von demselben Inhaber geführt, beschäftigen rund 50 Mitarbeiter und stehen seit Jahrzehnten für technisch anspruchsvolle Lösungen, die weltweit im Einsatz sind.

Während NOVAPAC Anlagen für die Lebensmittelindustrie entwickelt, insbesondere für Abfüll- und Verpackungslösungen, ist MASCHINPEX seit Jahrzehnten im Pharmabereich tätig und hat sich in einem spezialisierten Nischenmarkt etabliert.

Was uns besonders macht: Bei uns gibt es keine Serienproduktion. Jede Maschine ist ein Unikat, individuell geplant, konstruiert und über Monate hinweg umgesetzt. Ein Großteil unserer Projekte entsteht für internationale Kunden und wird weltweit eingesetzt. Wir begleiten unsere Anlagen von der ersten Idee bis zur Inbetriebnahme und schaffen Lösungen, die für unsere Kunden Wachstum und Weiterentwicklung ermöglichen.

Elektrokonstrukteur / Elektroprojektierer / Steuerungstechniker (w/m/d)

DEINE AUFGABEN

Je nach Erfahrung und Schwerpunkt liegt Dein Einstieg in der Elektrokonstruktion, Projektierung oder im Schaltschrankbau. Gleichzeitig hast Du die Möglichkeit, Dich fachlich in Richtung SPS-Programmierung, Inbetriebnahme und Service weiterzuentwickeln.

Dein Aufgabenbereich umfasst unter anderem:

- Je nach Schwerpunkt wirkst Du bei der Projektierung elektrischer Anlagen, der Erstellung von Schaltplänen und Stücklisten sowie der Auswahl geeigneter Komponenten mit.
- Du arbeitest an der Steuerungstechnik unserer Verpackungsmaschinen und Sonderanlagen und begleitest Projekte von der Planung bis zur Inbetriebnahme.
- Du erstellst, optimierst und betreust SPS-Programme, HMI-Visualisierungen sowie die Kommunikation zwischen Steuerungen, Antrieben und weiteren Anlagenkomponenten.
- Du führst Parametrierungen, I/O-Tests, Fehleranalysen und Inbetriebnahmen durch.
- Du prüfst technische Anforderungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Fachabteilungen passende Lösungen für unsere Kundenprojekte.
- Du integrierst externe Systeme und Komponenten in unsere Anlagen und unterstützt unsere Kunden bei technischen Fragestellungen, Schulungen und Serviceeinsätzen.

DEIN PROFIL

- Du hast eine Ausbildung als Elektroniker für Automatisierungstechnik, Elektroniker für Betriebstechnik, Elektroniker für Geräte und Systeme, Mechatroniker oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation abgeschlossen. Idealerweise verfügst Du über eine Weiterbildung zum Techniker oder Meister im Bereich Elektrotechnik oder Automatisierungstechnik.
- Idealerweise hast Du Erfahrung als Elektrokonstrukteur, Elektroplaner, Steuerungstechniker, SPS-Programmierer, Schaltschrankbauer oder Inbetriebnehmer oder in einer vergleichbaren technischen Funktion im Maschinenbau, Anlagenbau, Sondermaschinenbau oder im Bereich der Automatisierungstechnik.
- Du möchtest Dich fachlich weiterentwickeln? Auch Bewerber aus dem Schaltschrankbau, der Elektrik oder Mechatronik, die sich in Richtung SPS-Programmierung, Steuerungstechnik, Elektrokonstruktion oder Service weiterentwickeln möchten, sind ausdrücklich willkommen.
- Du bringst praktische elektrotechnische Erfahrung mit und kannst Schaltpläne sicher lesen. Idealerweise hast Du bereits Erfahrung im Schaltschrankbau, in der Maschinenverdrahtung, Elektrokonstruktion oder elektrischen Inbetriebnahme.
- Idealerweise bringst Du Kenntnisse in der SPS Programmierung mit, beispielsweise mit Schneider Electric, Codesys, Siemens TIA Portal oder vergleichbaren Systemen.
- Du hast Freude daran, technische Lösungen zu entwickeln und Maschinen von der Planung bis zur Inbetriebnahme zu begleiten.
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie Englischkenntnisse für die technische Kommunikation bringst Du mit.
- Gelegentliche Reisen für Inbetriebnahmen, Serviceeinsätze oder Kundenabnahmen stellen für Dich kein Problem dar.

DARAUF KANNST DU DICH FREUEN

- Dein Arbeitsplatz: Du arbeitest in einem modernen, hochwertig ausgestatteten Gebäude mit viel Raum und Blick ins Grüne. Im Pausenraum mit Terrasse und Blick auf den eigenen Teich kannst Du Deine Pause in angenehmer Atmosphäre genießen.
- Technische Herausforderungen statt Routine: Bei uns arbeitest Du nicht an Serienprodukten. Jede Maschine wird individuell für den Kunden entwickelt. Dadurch erwarten Dich abwechslungsreiche Projekte, technische Herausforderungen und immer wieder neue Aufgabenstellungen.
- Internationale Projekte: Du begleitest anspruchsvolle Projekte im Sondermaschinenbau mit Kunden weltweit und erhältst Einblicke in unterschiedliche Märkte, Kulturen und Arbeitsweisen.
- Gestaltungsspielraum: Bei uns kannst Du eigene Ideen einbringen, technische Lösungen mitgestalten und Verantwortung übernehmen. Kurze Entscheidungswege ermöglichen es, Dinge schnell umzusetzen.
- Dein Team: Dich erwartet ein eingespieltes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, das Dich im Arbeitsalltag unterstützt und herzlich willkommen heißt.
- Stabilität: Du arbeitest in einem etablierten, inhabergeführten Unternehmen im Sondermaschinenbau, in einer zukunftssicheren Branche mit langfristiger Perspektive und hoher Beständigkeit, die Dir ein sicheres Arbeitsumfeld bietet.
- **Attraktives Vergütungspaket:** Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, 13 Monatsgehälter sowie eine unbefristete und sichere Anstellung mit 30 Urlaubstagen.

DU WILLST TEIL UNSERER ERFOLGSGESCHICHTE WERDEN?

Dann bewirb Dich unkompliziert mit Deinem Lebenslauf.

title: Senior Specialist, Non-Financial Reporting (Business-Analyst/in)
description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Senior Specialist, Non-Financial Reporting

Stellenbeschreibung:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Senior Specialist, Non-Financial Reporting to join the Finance team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

This teammate will play a critical role in driving DH’s global CSRD-compliant (Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive) non-financial report disclosure across our network of brands and their operating countries. This role will work closely with the broader team responsible for non-financial reporting, key central stakeholders like Finance, People & Culture, Legal, Product, and other functions, but also global stakeholders from network brands. This teammate will help to implement transformative partnerships, roadmaps, and project plans to collate required quantitative and qualitative information, produce, and externally assure DH’s annual non-financial report. Over the next period this role will help evolve non-financial reporting, risk management, and internal controls up to par with financial reporting.

- Play a leading role in the production of the annual global non-financial report for the group.
- Develop communication materials to effectively engage stakeholders, providing clear context and guidance on CSRD reporting requirements
- Lead or support annual reporting on EU Taxonomy, non-financial risk assessment, and the coordination of new non-financial reporting regulations.
- Monitor the evolving regulatory landscape and ensure disclosures remain aligned with leading global frameworks, such as GRI, SASB, TCFD, and ISSB.
- Collaborate with Investor Relations on materials for, and queries from, investors; lead on annual ESG disclosures (e.g., potentially CDP).
- Support and lead on aspects of external assurance for the non-financial report; continue optimising and evolving related processes from year to year incl. automation.
- Lead on projects and initiatives that contribute to the reporting readiness of the Group in relation to the new regulations (CSRD).

Qualifications

- Strong interest and experience in leading non-financial reporting and external assurance work/working directly with auditors – in the corporate setting, or at a consultancy/as an auditor.
- Ability to learn quickly, with excellent qualitative analytical skills – to understand ESRS standards on various non-financial topics and help internal partner teams collate and refine disclosure content.
- Ability to process multiple workstreams at the same time, proven project management skills and attention to detail
- Degree in a field that builds related skills, knowledge and experience in a related role, with strong stakeholder management skills.
- Fluency in English and strong verbal, written, and presentation skills; proven organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to process multiple tasks and workstreams in parallel in a dynamic environment.
- A strong, flexible, and team/growth-oriented mindset.

Nice to have:

- Knowledge of German and European non-financial reporting regulations (CSRD, EU Taxonomy, NFRD), GRI, SASB, and especially TCFD
- Basic greenhouse gas (GHG) accounting principles.
- Fluency in German is a plus to ensure alignment between DH’s German and English non-financial report disclosures.

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym.
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

Ready to join our team? (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/howwehire) If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

title: Sales Specialist- Optoelectronics (Ingenieur/in - Optoelektronik)
description:
LCE Europe is a German subsidiary of the Lianchuang Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. (LCE) which was established in 2006 and listed on the SME Board of the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in December 2015 (stock code: 002036).

LCE focuses on the development of new optical and optoelectronic industries including optical lenses and image modules, touchscreen devices, etc., and invests and makes developments in electroacoustic and chip industries. The Group’s products are widely used in smart terminals, smart cars, smart homes, smart cities, etc.

For more than ten years, the Group has been continuously consolidating its industrial foundation, continuing to innovate and develop, and has successively established industrial bases in Jiangxi, Chongqing, Zhengzhou, Changzhou, Hefei, and other places as in Mexico and Vietnam.

The Group has established operation centers in the U.S. Bay Area, Hanover of Germany, Seoul of South Korea, and Shanghai to integrate top R&D talents at home and abroad，carry out applied research on cutting-edge technologies.

https://www.lcetron.com

Company size >10,000 employees

Role Description

We are seeking a highly motivated Sales Specialist with expertise in optoelectronics to expand our customer base and drive revenue growth. You will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, building strong client relationships, and promoting our cutting-edge optoelectronic products.

This Job is based in Hannover Region as a full/part-time hybrid role for a Sales Specialist with focus on Optoelectronics.

You will be responsible for

- Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve revenue targets in the optoelectronics market.
- Identify and engage potential clients including OEMs, distributors, and system integrators across key industries.
- Provide technical consultation, product recommendations, and customized solutions based on client requirements.
- Manage the full sales cycle – from lead generation and technical discussions to negotiation and deal closure.
- Collaborate with engineering, product, and marketing teams to align offerings with customer and market needs.
- Represent the company at trade shows, industry conferences, and client meetings.
- Continuously monitor industry trends, customer feedback, and competitor activities to inform business strategy.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Optical, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Business or related field
- Experience in the optoelectronics or automotive industry is a plus
- Knowledge of relevant software and hardware
- Demonstrated success in sales, account development, and market expansion.
- Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
- Strong results- and self- driven skills
- Motivated in learning new technologies and products
- Willing to travel
- Business fluent in English and Chinese, other languages is a plus

title: Network & Security Engineer (m/w/d) (Netzwerkadministrator/in)
description:
WIR HANDELN engagiert.
Mit rund 80 Fachhandelsstandorten zählt BAUKING gemeinsam mit den süddeutschen Tochtergesellschaften Mahler und Gebhardt zu den TOP-Unternehmen im deutschen Baustoff- und Holzfachhandel. BAUKING ist außerdem Hagebau Gesellschafter und betreibt rund 50 hagebaumärkte. Als Teil der europäischen Unternehmensgruppe Building Materials Europe (BME), bieten wir als BAUKING unseren Profikunden und privaten Heimwerkenden in Deutschland über 70.000 Artikel sowie kompetente Beratung und professionelle Dienstleistungen für das jeweilige Bauprojekt an. Mit einer LKW-Flotte von über 230 Fahrzeugen beliefern wir täglich unsere KundInnen. Unseren Erfolg haben wir als BAUKING vor allem dem engagierten und leidenschaftlichen Einsatz unserer über 3.800 Mitarbeitenden zu verdanken.
Sie leben für Kundenzufriedenheit und haben Lust, unser Team noch erfolgreicher zu machen? Dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig!

Unser Paket für Sie:

- 30 Tage Urlaub bei einer 5 Tage-Woche (Teilzeit anteilig) sowie Sonderurlaub für besondere Anlässe
- Mobiles Arbeiten (40%) und flexible Arbeitszeiten
- Mitarbeiterrabatte in unseren eigenen Märkten
- Attraktive Rabatte bei Corporate Benefits
- (E-) Bike Leasing (JobRad) mit Zuschuss von BAUKING
- Ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz mit Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
- internes Schulungsangebot und individuelle Entwicklungsmaßnahmen
- Kostenfreie Parkplätze direkt am Gebäude
- Ein herzliches und motiviertes Team vor Ort

So packen Sie mit an:

- Sie agieren als Security Champion und Schnittstelle zur konzernzentralen IT-Security der BME-Gruppe
- Sie übersetzen Sicherheitsanforderungen in konkrete Maßnahmen und Rollout-Strategien
- Sie koordinieren Rollouts mit anderen IT-Teams und sorgen für reibungslose Umsetzungen
- Sie steuern Managed-Service-Provider im Netzwerkbereich (LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, VPN) und begleiten Providerwechsel
- Sie verantworten den WLAN-Betrieb unserer rund 140 Standorte
- Sie arbeiten eng mit dem externen Security Operations Center zusammen, bewerten Incidents und unterstützen bei der Eindämmung

Das haben Sie im Gepäck:

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb oder der Steuerung von Unternehmensnetzwerken (LAN/WAN, SD-WAN), idealerweise in Cisco-Umgebungen
- Praxis im Umgang mit Firewalls und VPN-Anbindungen
- Sie haben sich bereits mit IT-Security-Themen (z. B. Hardening, Patch-Management, Incident Handling) beschäftigt und möchten diesen Schwerpunkt gezielt ausbauen
- Sie fühlen sich wohl in einer Rolle, in der Sie Konzeption, Abstimmung und Steuerung von Dienstleistern übernehmen, statt alles selbst zu konfigurieren
- Sie bringen Kommunikationsstärke mit und können technische Inhalte verständlich für verschiedene Zielgruppen aufbereiten
- Von Vorteil sind Kenntnisse in CrowdStrike, PKI-/Zertifikatsmanagement im Microsoft-Umfeld, NAC-Lösungen und/oder Azure Firewall

Interessiert?
Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre aussagekräftige Onlinebewerbung.
Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Hintergründe – unabhängig von ethnischer, nationaler oder sozialer Herkunft, geschlechtlicher Identität, Religion, Behinderung, Alter oder sexueller Orientierung. Zeigen Sie uns, was Sie einzigartig macht!

title: CFD Software Developer (Softwareentwickler/in)
description:
CFD Software Engineer (f/m/d)
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the
world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative
global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a
large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together
while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages
creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our
business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
Position Overview
Are you a passionate Software Engineer who enjoys working at
the intersection of numerical methods, high-performance computing, and
real-world engineering applications? We are searching for a talented CFD
Software Engineer to join our solver development team for Simcenter Ultrafluid (formerly Altair ultraFluidX, https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/) ), a small, dynamic, and agile team delivering world-class CFD software to
industries including automotive, heavy industry, and consumer electronics.
Simcenter Ultrafluid features a native GPU-based
implementation of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), allowing users to run
fully transient, high-fidelity aerodynamics and aeroacoustics simulations
overnight on a single compute server. The solver is designed to handle complex
geometries and demanding industrial use cases, delivering high-fidelity,
predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.
If you are seeking a role where you can contribute directly
to solver development, algorithm implementation, and GPU acceleration, while
translating cutting-edge academic research in numerical methods into a
high-performance, easy-to-use software product, and collaborating closely with
the whole development team on the advancement of the code and its capabilities,
then we'd love to hear from you!
Responsibilities

- Contribute
to the code development of Simcenter Ultrafluid as part of the agile
development team
- Specify,
implement, test, and document new high-quality features of the solver in
close collaboration with the other team members
- Contribute
to performance benchmarking and code optimization in a massively parallel
GPU environment, while collaborating with other development teams across
HPC, pre/post-processing, and meshing to integrate Simcenter Ultrafluid
into the broader Simcenter ecosystem
- Collaborate
with product management, application specialists, and QA engineers to
ensure the solver meets real-world industrial needs
- Participate
in daily stand-ups as well as regular review, retrospective, and planning
meetings

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

- M.Sc.
or Ph.D. degree in mechanical engineering, computational mechanics,
computer science, or a comparable physics-based discipline
- At
least two years of hands-on experience in CFD solver development in a
commercial or academic environment
- High
proficiency in C++ and parallel programming
- Excellent
English communication skills
- Passion
for numerical simulation and a drive to find creative solutions for
challenging industrial use cases with a focus on customer value
- Willingness
to work in a close-knit, agile development team

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience
with scripting or scientific programming languages such as Python or Julia
- Solid
understanding of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and its application in
CFD
- Solid
understanding of GPU architectures and experience with the CUDA toolkit

Why us?
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by
default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than
200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through
real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale
and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and
inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring you curiosity
and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.
. Escalating requests that cannot be resolved to other team members, and team leaders located both in the UK and Germany.
. Delivering service excellence by efficiently problem-solving and reacting in a professional, polite and clear manner.
. Accurately logging all Dealer contacts and following up on cases using Opel/Vauxhall database systems.
. Attending team and other meetings for review of issues, assignments, regular discussion.

What we're looking for:
. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

Budaörs is a small city of around 30,000 people, situated at the southern edge of the Buda Hills less than 10km from Budapest. The city offers contemporary architecture, the picturesque old town, breath-taking natural surroundings and historic monuments. You can reach Budapest in a matter of minutes via road or public transport.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Associate Development Director and Advisor
description:
About Contradictum Advisory ehf.

Contradictum Advisory ehf. is a startup dedicated to advising international intellectual property holders in the management and licensing their assets with the objective to steer part of that revenue stream into underfunded projects in Iceland.  Particular emphasis is placed on projects that both serve an immediate domestic need in Iceland and that would meet eligibility requirements under the European Union Green Bond Standard and qualify for the Nordic Swan ecolabel.
Associate Development Director and Advisor.

This is a client-facing position comprised of two primary areas of competence.  The first is in providing advisory and consulting services to intellectual property owners in the North American Market with respect to the use, management, and monetization of their IP portfolios.  The second is in facilitating the investment of IP derived revenue into Iceland-based projects.  Our customer base is comprised of individuals, privately held companies, and family offices who are open diversifying their holdings in EEA and EFTA jurisdictions.  Your role will be to effectively assist clients with maximizing IP derived revenue and presenting opportunities to invest that revenue into target projects in Iceland.  A solid understanding of intellectual property, contracts, procurement processes is essential.  

Main tasks and Responsibilities:
•    Provide strategic direction to clients with respect to intellectual property licensing within the relevant jurisdictional frameworks of each client portfolio.
•    Prepare and present pitch decks to potential investment partners.  
•    Develop investment-ready Iceland-based project proposals.
•    Manage and develop local network of interested counterpart stakeholder and professional service providers related to each project proposal.
•    Identify and liaise with potential new high-net-worth individual investors and small-midsized family office clients in North, Central, and South American markets.
•    Demonstrate extraordinary discretion in all interactions with clients, maintaining the utmost in confidentiality and candor.

Education and licensing:
•    Advanced university-level business or legal education required.  Doctorate of Jurisprudence or Masters of Business Administration with coursework in contracts or international transactions from a top university strongly preferred.
•    Educational coursework in environmental or natural resources usage from an Icelandic University preferred.
•    Admittance to practice before to any US Federal Court.
•    Membership in any North America-based First Nation or Tribal Bar Association strongly preferred.

Qualification Requirements:
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in intellectual property licensing.
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in real property development or prime-contractor representation is highly desirable
•    Minimum 3years of experience in international transactions is highly desirable.
•    Solid Understanding of USPTO and EUIPO standards and procedures.
•    Knowledge of securities and BizOp regulatory standards and requirements is highly desirable.
•    Ability to operate effectively in a multi-time-zone framework convenient to international client domestic work hours.

Language Skills:  Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation English skills are essential.  Additional languages are beneficial.
English [Required] Expert Level
Icelandic [Optional] Intermediate
Spanish [Optional] Intermediate

Compensation:
Compensation is chiefly commission based plus a minimum base salary of 500,000 ISK per month.

Work Hours:
Flexible working hours generally overlapping with the North American Market.  Schedule is expected to vary based on specific client/project needs.
Contact:  For more information, please contact us at CAEHF@proton.me

title: Animal Care Manager
description:
The Beluga Operating Company ehf is seeking an animal care manager.

What you'll bring to the team
Lead the Future of Beluga Whale Conservation
Imagine waking up each day knowing your work is helping shape the future of one of the world's most unique marine conservation projects.

At the SEA LIFE TRUST Beluga Whale Sanctuary, you'll lead an experienced team dedicated to providing world-class care for Little Grey and Little White, our resident belugas, while also overseeing the welfare of rescued puffins and our aquarium collection.


This is far more than an animal care management role. It's an opportunity to combine exceptional leadership, animal welfare expertise and conservation passion at the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.

If you're an inspiring leader with extensive experience working with cetaceans or large marine mammals, we'd love to hear from you.


As our Animal Care Manager (Curator), you'll lead all aspects of animal care, welfare and husbandry across the sanctuary.

Working closely with the General Manager and the wider SEA LIFE TRUST and Merlin Entertainments teams, you'll ensure our animals receive exceptional care while supporting scientific research, conservation, education and unforgettable guest experiences.


You'll lead, coach and develop a passionate team of animal care professionals whilst ensuring the highest standards of welfare, safety and operational excellence.

What You'll Be Doing
Leading World-Class Animal Care
Lead the care, health and welfare of our resident beluga whales, puffins and aquarium animals.
Oversee animal husbandry, enrichment, operant conditioning and behavioural management.
Ensure excellent standards across all animal habitats and life support systems.
Drive continual improvements in animal welfare and husbandry practices.
Leading and Developing People
Inspire, coach and develop a highly skilled animal care team.
Create a culture of collaboration, continuous learning and professional development.
Provide leadership during day-to-day operations and emergency response situations.
Ensure clear performance expectations and high professional standards.
Conservation & Collaboration
Work alongside veterinarians, conservation partners, researchers and animal welfare specialists.
Provide expert advice to the SEA LIFE TRUST, Merlin Entertainments and external stakeholders on cetacean care.
Support ongoing conservation programmes and future sanctuary developments.
Operational Excellence
Manage departmental budgets, veterinary services and critical animal care resources.
Ensure compliance with animal welfare legislation, licensing requirements and health & safety standards.
Oversee record keeping, husbandry documentation and life support operations.
Participate in the animal care call-out rota.
Inspiring Others
Help bring conservation to life by engaging with guests, media and local communities.
Support educational programmes and public awareness initiatives.
Act as an ambassador for the SEA LIFE TRUST and our conservation mission.
Qualifications & Experience
We're looking for someone who combines exceptional technical expertise with outstanding leadership.

You'll ideally have:

Essential
At least 10 years' experience working within a cetacean, aquarium or zoological environment, including significant leadership experience.
Extensive knowledge of marine mammal behaviour, training and welfare.
Proven experience leading and developing professional animal care teams.
Strong understanding of operant conditioning, enrichment and husbandry.
Excellent communication and decision-making skills.
Strong swimming ability and confidence working in open water.
Ability to work from boats and in challenging marine environments.
Fluent English.
Ability to obtain the legal right to live and work in Iceland.
Desirable
Degree in Zoology, Biology or a related discipline.
Experience with Life Support Systems (LSS).
Drysuit or cold-water diving qualifications.
PADI Rescue Diver (or higher).
Veterinary technical experience.
Bird rehabilitation experience.
First Aid qualification.
Experience handling cetaceans in open-water environments.
Benefits
This isn't just another animal care leadership role.

You'll be joining one of the world's most recognised marine conservation charities and helping shape the future of marine mammal welfare.

You'll have the opportunity to:

Lead the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.
Work with internationally respected animal welfare experts.
Influence global conservation and welfare standards.
Develop and mentor an exceptional animal care team.
Make a genuine difference to the lives of marine animals every single day.
Live and work in the stunning natural surroundings of Iceland.
About the SEA LIFE TRUST
The SEA LIFE TRUST is a global marine conservation charity dedicated to protecting the world's oceans and marine wildlife through conservation, education and campaigning.

Our Beluga Whale Sanctuary in Iceland provides a safe, natural environment for formerly captive beluga whales while inspiring millions of people to care for our oceans.

Together, we're creating a future where marine life can thrive.

If you're an experienced animal care leader who shares our passion for conservation, welfare and exceptional animal care, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of marine conservation.

title: Join Iceland´s Acute Medicine Team - Consultant Physician
description:
Join Iceland's Acute Medicine Team - Consultant Physician

Help Shape the Future of Acute and Internal Medicine in Iceland

Are you an ambitious and enthusiastic Consultant Physician looking for an opportunity to make a lasting impact? Would you like to build a career with purpose in one of the world's most beautiful, and progressive countries?

Landspitali is undertaking one of the largest transformations of urgent and emergency care in its history. We are seeking Consultant Physicians in Internal Medicine and/or Acute Internal Medicine to join our multidisciplinary team as we design, develop and deliver the next generation of emergency services in Iceland working in a leading university hospital committed to innovation, education, and research.

Experience an outstanding work-life balance in Reykjavík, where a vibrant capital city meets spectacular nature. Physicians' standard daytime working hours are based on a 36-hour working week. Enjoy safe communities, short commutes, world-class outdoor adventures, excellent schools and healthcare, and easy access to Europe and North America.

Landspitali is developing a new integrated model of urgent and emergency care focused on:
•    Improving patient flow
•    Delivering safer, more efficient and person-centered care
•    Developing innovative pathways for acutely ill patients

Successful applicants will play a key role in developing several new clinical services, including:
•    Acute Medical Unit (AMU)
•    Same Day Emergency Care (SDEC)
•    Hospital at Home

Why join Landspitali we offer:
•    A rewarding consultant-level position
•    Opportunities to take on leadership roles in developing new services
•    Close collaboration with experienced multidisciplinary teams
•    An academic environment where clinical excellence, research, teaching and innovation go hand in hand
•    The opportunity to contribute to a transformation that will benefit thousands of patients every year
•    Excellent opportunities to achieve a healthy work life balance.
•    A supportive working environment that values staff wellbeing and professional development.
•    Structured Icelandic language training, including formal courses and digital learning resources.

The position is full-time (100%) or as otherwise agreed and is available immediately or by mutual agreement.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:
•    Clinical work across inpatient wards, the Acute Medical Assessment Unit (AMAU), and Same Day Emergency Care (SDEC) services
•    Participation in the General Internal Medicine inpatient admitting team
•    Participation in the General Internal Medicine on-call rota
•    Teaching and supervision of medical students and resident doctors in training
•    Opportunities to participate in research activities
•    Participation in quality improvement and patient safety initiative
•    Contributing to the ongoing development of Acute Medicine and General Internal Medicine services

QUALIFICATIONS:
•    Specialist registration (or equivalent) in General Internal Medicine, Acute Internal Medicine, or Family Medicine/General Practice with an emphasis on Acute Care
•    Broad clinical experience in Acute and/or General Internal Medicine
•    Excellent communication and the ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team
•    A commitment to quality improvement, innovation and the development of high-value healthcare services.

ABOUT THE POSITION AND APPLICATION:
Salary according to the current collective agreement concluded by the Minister of Finance and the Economy and the Medical Association of Iceland. It also depends on factors such as additional education, professional experience, and years of service. Physicians who are fully dedicated to the position in Landspítali may also receive an additional 15% salary premium in accordance with the collective agreement.

Applicants will be interviewed and decision to hire will be based on the information and documents provided by the applicants. Landspitali equal opportunities policy is taken into account when hiring at the hospital. All applications will be responded to.

•    A completed application form

•    Certified copies of medical degree(s), specialist qualifications and medical licence(s)

Do you enjoy balancing technical fieldwork with meaningful ecological impact? Are you ready to lead surveys, mentor early-career colleagues, and deliver high-quality reports? Are you looking for a role that offers variety, autonomy, and the chance to shape your ecological career? We’re looking for a Senior Ecologist to join Woodrow (part of the APEM Group) in Ireland. This is an exciting opportunity to take the next step in your consultancy career—delivering high-quality ecological assessments, leading fieldwork across diverse Irish habitats, and contributing to nationally significant environmental projects. You will work with other ecology professionals in our office in Sligo. Around 50% of your time will involve fieldwork, including travel across Ireland (and occasionally Northern Ireland or the UK), so confidence working in dynamic, outdoor settings is key. As a Senior Ecologist, you’ll lead survey programmes, deliver technical reports (e.g. EcIA, AA Screening, NIS, EIAR), manage small to mid-sized projects, and guide junior ecologists. You’ll also have opportunities to contribute to tender writing, service development, and cross-disciplinary collaboration with experts across the wider APEM Group.  Have you got what it takes to be our new Jetty Operator in Dublin? We want to hear from you! What would your day at GAC look like? Ensuring vessels are moored correctly and in alignment with shore loading arms and connections Ensuring vessels provide safe access via correctly rigged gangways, which must be monitored and maintained throughout discharge operations Connection and disconnection of ‘off-loading equipment’ (hoses/loading arms/spool pieces etc.) Monitoring and adjusting connections, as required Ensuring valves are opened/closed for safe, efficient discharge of client products Taking ship samples, as required Performing line walks and repetitive checks during discharge operations Completion of documentation as required What are we looking for? This is your chance to become part of the global GAC team which has been providing professional shipping, logistics and marine services since 1956. Everything we do is guided by the GAC Spirit, built on mutual loyalty between management and staff, and a belief in the value of our people as individuals - not just for the jobs they do. With more than 7,500 colleagues in 300 strategically located offices in more than 50 countries around the world, we focus on quality, safety and sustainability with a human touch. Emphasising a long-term approach, innovation and ethics, our flexible and integrated portfolios are designed to work within and support our customers’ operations.   As our Jetty Operator in Dublin, you will have the opportunity to work as part of a team who apply the highest standard of customer services to everything we do and aim to be industry leaders within all the sectors we serve.   GAC Ireland gives you the opportunity to work for an employer who is committed to offering all our staff an enjoyable and rewarding career, with significant training and development prospects. In 2021, we launched our ten-year sustainability programme – MARS30. We are committed to “growing long term customer relationships across multiple products, whilst significantly reducing our environmental impact, improving the well-being of our people, and influencing our stakeholders to do the same.” We will accomplish our by mission by completing objectives aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).     At GAC Ireland, who you are is just as important as what you do. The GAC Spirit reflects our culture across the company, emphasising loyalty and understanding between management and staff. We recognise that people’s lives extend far beyond their jobs. By promoting a healthy combination of work and play

Responsabilità principali - Definire roadmap, posizionamento e 'pacchetti' dei servizi commerciali satellite enabled. - Disegnare e lanciare offerte wholesale: modelli di partnership, livelli di servizio (SLA) e pricing. - Raccogliere esigenze da clienti/partner e tradurle in requisiti operativi e deliverable per i team coinvolti. - Identificare verticali prioritari, sviluppare opportunità commerciali e portare i pilot a contratti ricorrenti. - Selezionare e validare componenti e partner necessari all'erogazione del servizio (dispositivi/terminali e servizi di piattaforma/ground). Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale Location: Milano, Italia (ibrido valutabile) Package: RAL 70-100K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio #LI-CP Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. L'offerta si intende rivolta a candidati e candidate, nel rispetto del D.Lgs. n. 198/2006 e ss.mm.ii. e dei Decreti Legislativi n. 215 e n. 216 del 2003 sulle parità di trattamento. title: CFD Software Developer (Softwareentwickler/in)
description:
CFD Software Engineer (f/m/d)
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the
world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative
global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a
large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together
while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages
creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our
business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
Position Overview
Are you a passionate Software Engineer who enjoys working at
the intersection of numerical methods, high-performance computing, and
real-world engineering applications? We are searching for a talented CFD
Software Engineer to join our solver development team for Simcenter Ultrafluid (formerly Altair ultraFluidX, https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/) ), a small, dynamic, and agile team delivering world-class CFD software to
industries including automotive, heavy industry, and consumer electronics.
Simcenter Ultrafluid features a native GPU-based
implementation of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), allowing users to run
fully transient, high-fidelity aerodynamics and aeroacoustics simulations
overnight on a single compute server. The solver is designed to handle complex
geometries and demanding industrial use cases, delivering high-fidelity,
predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.
If you are seeking a role where you can contribute directly
to solver development, algorithm implementation, and GPU acceleration, while
translating cutting-edge academic research in numerical methods into a
high-performance, easy-to-use software product, and collaborating closely with
the whole development team on the advancement of the code and its capabilities,
then we'd love to hear from you!
Responsibilities

- Contribute
to the code development of Simcenter Ultrafluid as part of the agile
development team
- Specify,
implement, test, and document new high-quality features of the solver in
close collaboration with the other team members
- Contribute
to performance benchmarking and code optimization in a massively parallel
GPU environment, while collaborating with other development teams across
HPC, pre/post-processing, and meshing to integrate Simcenter Ultrafluid
into the broader Simcenter ecosystem
- Collaborate
with product management, application specialists, and QA engineers to
ensure the solver meets real-world industrial needs
- Participate
in daily stand-ups as well as regular review, retrospective, and planning
meetings

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

- M.Sc.
or Ph.D. degree in mechanical engineering, computational mechanics,
computer science, or a comparable physics-based discipline
- At
least two years of hands-on experience in CFD solver development in a
commercial or academic environment
- High
proficiency in C++ and parallel programming
- Excellent
English communication skills
- Passion
for numerical simulation and a drive to find creative solutions for
challenging industrial use cases with a focus on customer value
- Willingness
to work in a close-knit, agile development team

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience
with scripting or scientific programming languages such as Python or Julia
- Solid
understanding of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and its application in
CFD
- Solid
understanding of GPU architectures and experience with the CUDA toolkit

Why us?
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by
default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than
200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through
real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale
and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and
inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring you curiosity
and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

title: geologo/geologa
description: Grafton ICT* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito AI, Data, Cybersecurity, Cloud, ERP & CRM, Sistemi e Infrastrutture, IMAC e Sviluppo. Per ampliamento nostro network di candidati specializzati, ricerchiamo candidati e candidate interessati/e a valutare opportunità come: RAMS / ILS ENGINEER Le posizioni che potremo proporti potranno includere attività quali: Guidare le attività RAMS (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety) lungo il ciclo di vita del prodotto; definire gli obiettivi RAM, allocare i requisiti e pianificare i programmi RAM (previsioni, suddivisione, crescita). Eseguire analisi di affidabilità (MIL-HDBK-217F, parts-count/physics-of-failure), modellazione di disponibilità e costi del ciclo di vita (MTBF/MTTR, Ao) e analisi di manutenibilità (tempi delle attività, dimostrazioni di manutenibilità). Realizzare ingegneria della sicurezza secondo ARP4754A/ARP4761 e MIL-STD-882E: FHA, FTA/ETA, PRA, classificazione dei rischi e monitoraggio delle mitigazioni. Implementare e gestire il processo FRACAS per la raccolta dei difetti di campo/test, analisi delle cause radice, azioni correttive/preventive e crescita dell'affidabilità (es. Crow-AMSAA). Guidare l'Integrated Product Support (IPS/ILS): LSA/LSAR secondo ASD S-Series (S2000M, S3000L, S5000F); sviluppare banche dati di supporto logistico (LSDB), elenchi ricambi, attrezzature di supporto (STTE), piani di manutenzione e allineamento della documentazione tecnica (S1000D). Condurre analisi FMEA/FMECA e MTA/RCM; raccomandare modifiche progettuali e miglioramenti alla supportabilità (DfR, DfM, DfS, DfMtn). Gestire la governance dell'obsolescenza: monitoraggio del ciclo di vita, pianificazione Last Time Buy (LTB), ricerca di soluzioni Fit-Form-Function (FFF) alternative, analisi degli impatti d'uso e report di chiusura. Definire i supporti ai test e qualifiche (ambientale/elettrica/EMC) e contribuire alle verifiche di conformità ed accettazione (FAT/SAT). Realizzare dashboard e monitoraggio KPI per le performance RAMS/ILS; pubblicare report periodici e supportare i review di progetto (SRR/PDR/CDR). Mantenere un solido controllo di configurazione in PLM/ERP; garantire la conformità a qualità (ISO 9001/EN 9100), HSE e alle politiche di sicurezza delle informazioni/export-control. Hai queste caratteristiche? Laurea triennale o magistrale in Ingegneria o discipline STEM affini. Competenza nell'uso di strumenti RAMS (es. Windchill Quality Solutions/ReliaSoft), sistemi di requisiti/PLM/ERP (es. DOORS/DOORS Next, Teamcenter, SAP) e analisi dati (Excel/Power BI; SQL). Conoscenza degli standard ASD S-Series (S2000M, S3000L, S5000F), MIL-STD-1388 (LSA/LSAR) e dei principali framework di safety engineering (ARP4754A/ARP4761, MIL-STD-882E). Capacità di redigere documentazione tecnica in inglese (report di supportabilità, FMECA/FHA/FTA, piani di manutenzione, estratti LSDB) e di gestire baseline/variazioni di configurazione. Luogo di lavoro: Roma, Genova, Torino, Firenze Entrando nel nostro data-base, potremo contattarti quando saranno disponibili posizioni coerenti con la tua esperienza, le tue competenze e la tua disponibilità. Vuoi essere considerato/a per future opportunità? Inviaci la tua candidatura. Non perdere l'opportunità di unirti a noi come Addetto/Addetta al magazzino! Non hai esperienza nel ruolo? Non preoccuparti! Siamo Gi Group e per lo stabilimento Amazon di DVN5 (Marcon - Venezia) cerchiamo proprio te! title: assistente di negozio
description: Unisciti al team di Acqua & Sapone! Gi Group, la prima multinazionale del lavoro italiana, sta cercando Addetti/Addette alle Vendite per Acqua & Sapone, leader nel mondo della bellezza e igiene. Cosa ti aspetta? - Un ambiente di lavoro stimolante e accogliente, dove sentirti parte di una grande famiglia; - Percorsi di crescita strutturati per valorizzare il tuo talento e costruire una carriera solida; - Un contratto iniziale a tempo determinato con reali possibilità di assunzione a tempo indeterminato. Cosa farai ogni giorno: - Organizzerai e riassortirai scaffali, curando l'ordine del punto vendita; - Gestirai l'arrivo della merce, smontando bancali e sistemando i prodotti; - Offrirai assistenza ai clienti con il tuo sorriso e la tua competenza; - Ti occuperai della prezzatura dei prodotti e della gestione della cassa; - Allestirai spazi espositivi e isole promozionali per stupire i clienti; - Controllerai inventari e ti occuperai dei riordini. title: Assemblers
description: ADDETTO/A ALL'ASSEMBLAGGIO MECCANICO Per realtà metalmeccanica ricerchiamo una figura da inserire come addetto assemblaggio con scopo inserimento. SCOPO DEL RUOLO Assemblare correttamente le parti meccaniche nel rispetto delle indicazioni ricevute e delle procedure aziendali. Supportare il funzionamento e la manutenzione dei macchinari. RESPONSABILITA' Puntualità e correttezza nell'esecuzione delle procedure di assemblaggio Pulizia e manutenzione dei macchinari Messa in sicurezza delle macchine Ottemperamento degli standard di qualità aziendali Rispetto delle tempistiche previste PRINCIPALI MANSIONI Si occupa dell'assemblaggio meccanico dei componenti di una ginocchiera: posiziona manualmente i velcri adesivi, assembla i passanti, le cuffie e la parte superiore ed inferiore delle ginocchiera tramite una piastrina che viene rivettata, piega le parti in alluminio e confeziona manualmente la ginocchiera. Sulla base delle necessità produttive, utilizza le macchine rivettatrici, le presse, le calandre, le imboccolatrici, prestando attenzione alla corretta messa in sicurezza della macchina e al corretto settaggio prima dell'uso. Verifica la sicurezza e la funzionalità dei macchinari che utilizza quotidianamente. Segue con attenzione le istruzioni per il corretto assemblaggio di ogni parte di ciascuna lavorazione. Effettua la pulizia e la manutenzione delle macchine con l'aria compressa e appositi panni. Effettua il rabbocco dell'olio nei macchinari utilizzati. Gestisce l'inventario utilizzando il conto manuale e la bilancia di precisione contapezzi con cui si contano i componenti presenti in reparto. Si interfaccia con area UT per lo sviluppo di campioni e/o per l'effettuazione di test funzionali. Interagisce con Area CQ per risolvere possibili NC emerse durante il ciclo produttivo. Utilizza quotidianamente attrezzature e strumenti da banco (quali a titolo di esempio trapani, pinze, cacciaviti) per ottimizzare l'assemblaggio meccanico. COMPETENZE TECNICHE Preferibili conoscenze delle procedure di assemblaggio dei componenti meccanici Preferibile conoscenza dei macchinari utilizzati in azienda (presse, calandre, imboccolatrici) Preferibile conoscenza nell'utilizzo di attrezzature manuali (cacciaviti, pinze) Preferibile conoscenza nell'utilizzo di strumenti elettrici (avvitatori, trapani) Orario di lavoro: full-time dal lunedì al venerdì 08.00-12.00/13.00-17.00 Offerta Contrattuale: - Inserimento con contratto di somministrazione a tempo determinato - CCNL applicato: metalmeccanici PMI - Livello di inquadramento: 3° livello - Retribuzione prevista: circa 2000 lordi mensili Luogo di lavoro: Dossobuono di Villafranca (Vr) Via A. description: Grafton ICT* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito AI, Data, Cybersecurity, Cloud, ERP & CRM, Sistemi e Infrastrutture, IMAC e Sviluppo. Per ampliamento nostro network di candidati specializzati, ricerchiamo candidati e candidate interessati/e a valutare opportunità come: RAMS / ILS ENGINEER Le posizioni che potremo proporti potranno includere attività quali: Guidare le attività RAMS (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety) lungo il ciclo di vita del prodotto; definire gli obiettivi RAM, allocare i requisiti e pianificare i programmi RAM (previsioni, suddivisione, crescita). Eseguire analisi di affidabilità (MIL-HDBK-217F, parts-count/physics-of-failure), modellazione di disponibilità e costi del ciclo di vita (MTBF/MTTR, Ao) e analisi di manutenibilità (tempi delle attività, dimostrazioni di manutenibilità). Realizzare ingegneria della sicurezza secondo ARP4754A/ARP4761 e MIL-STD-882E: FHA, FTA/ETA, PRA, classificazione dei rischi e monitoraggio delle mitigazioni. Implementare e gestire il processo FRACAS per la raccolta dei difetti di campo/test, analisi delle cause radice, azioni correttive/preventive e crescita dell'affidabilità (es. Crow-AMSAA). Guidare l'Integrated Product Support (IPS/ILS): LSA/LSAR secondo ASD S-Series (S2000M, S3000L, S5000F); sviluppare banche dati di supporto logistico (LSDB), elenchi ricambi, attrezzature di supporto (STTE), piani di manutenzione e allineamento della documentazione tecnica (S1000D). Condurre analisi FMEA/FMECA e MTA/RCM; raccomandare modifiche progettuali e miglioramenti alla supportabilità (DfR, DfM, DfS, DfMtn). Gestire la governance dell'obsolescenza: monitoraggio del ciclo di vita, pianificazione Last Time Buy (LTB), ricerca di soluzioni Fit-Form-Function (FFF) alternative, analisi degli impatti d'uso e report di chiusura. Definire i supporti ai test e qualifiche (ambientale/elettrica/EMC) e contribuire alle verifiche di conformità ed accettazione (FAT/SAT). Realizzare dashboard e monitoraggio KPI per le performance RAMS/ILS; pubblicare report periodici e supportare i review di progetto (SRR/PDR/CDR). Mantenere un solido controllo di configurazione in PLM/ERP; garantire la conformità a qualità (ISO 9001/EN 9100), HSE e alle politiche di sicurezza delle informazioni/export-control. Hai queste caratteristiche? Laurea triennale o magistrale in Ingegneria o discipline STEM affini. Competenza nell'uso di strumenti RAMS (es. Windchill Quality Solutions/ReliaSoft), sistemi di requisiti/PLM/ERP (es. DOORS/DOORS Next, Teamcenter, SAP) e analisi dati (Excel/Power BI; SQL). Conoscenza degli standard ASD S-Series (S2000M, S3000L, S5000F), MIL-STD-1388 (LSA/LSAR) e dei principali framework di safety engineering (ARP4754A/ARP4761, MIL-STD-882E). Capacità di redigere documentazione tecnica in inglese (report di supportabilità, FMECA/FHA/FTA, piani di manutenzione, estratti LSDB) e di gestire baseline/variazioni di configurazione. Luogo di lavoro: Roma, Genova, Torino, Firenze Entrando nel nostro data-base, potremo contattarti quando saranno disponibili posizioni coerenti con la tua esperienza, le tue competenze e la tua disponibilità.
